title: How to Build a Booking App Like Calendly (Without Code)
summary: Build a custom booking app with calendar availability, email confirmations, and Stripe payments — without a developer. Step-by-step guide using Blink.
body_markdown: A Blink-built booking app handles the same core workflow: availability display, booking form, confirmation emails, and calendar sync. Calendly has native integrations with Salesforce and HubSpot out of the box — those require API integrations in a custom build. A custom Blink app wins on pricing (no per-seat fees), custom branding, flexible intake forms, and data ownership. For most consultants and service businesses, the custom build is the better long-term choice.
